name: Fitness to drive and medical conditions
description: National medical standards and state licensing context for people whose disability or medical condition may affect safe driving, including conditional licences, practical assessments and vehicle modifications.
care_team_notes: Do not tell someone whether they personally can drive. Advise discussing changes with their doctor and state/territory licensing authority, especially with progressive weakness, fatigue, medications or cognitive change.

name: NDIS vehicle modifications
description: NDIS information on vehicle modifications for driving or travelling as a passenger, evidence requirements, doctor reports, driver-trained OT assessments, quotes, repairs and limits on what NDIS does not fund.
care_team_notes: Be clear that NDIS may fund disability-related modifications but not purchase, registration, ordinary running costs or general driving lessons.

name: Driver-trained occupational therapy assessment
description: Information on when driver-trained OT assessment may be needed for modified driving controls, vehicle-specific disability driving tests, safety certification and training in using vehicle modifications.
care_team_notes: For MND, link this with occupational therapy, physiotherapy, fatigue, weakness, reaction time, respiratory equipment and communication needs.

name: Australian disability parking permits
publisher: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing / myGov
description: National disability parking scheme information and state/territory application pathways for mobility parking permits and concessions.
care_team_notes: Tell users to check their state/territory authority for eligibility, application, cost and local parking rules. Permits must only be used when transporting the permit holder.

name: Patient travel assistance schemes
publisher: myGov / state and territory health services
description: State and territory patient travel subsidy pathways for people who need to travel long distances for medical treatment, including travel and accommodation support links.
care_team_notes: Ask the user's state/territory and appointment location before answering. These schemes differ by jurisdiction and usually need forms/referrals/receipts.

name: Community transport and accessible transport
description: Disability Gateway and myGov transport guidance, including community transport, accessible parking, state/territory resources and transport subsidies.
care_team_notes: For practical answers, combine this with the person's MND association, local council, NDIS transport funding, My Aged Care transport support and carer availability.

name: State modified vehicle rules
description: State examples for modified vehicles, licence conditions, certification, medical certificates and when a vehicle-specific driving test or modified-vehicle condition may apply.
care_team_notes: Use state examples carefully. Ask location and refer to that state/territory authority because licence and vehicle certification processes differ.

name: DVA vehicle modification support
description: DVA vehicle modification and driving assessment information for eligible veterans with accepted service-related injuries or illnesses that limit mobility.
care_team_notes: Only suggest this pathway if the user may be DVA-entitled. It is separate from NDIS and state transport schemes.
